meta.description: Your recipe book: save, import, and share recipes on every device.

welcome.title: All your recipes, in one drawer.
welcome.lead: Snap the pages of grandma's cookbook, paste a link, or type it in. Mestolo keeps everything organized and ready on your phone, tablet, and computer.
welcome.point1: From photos of several pages, a link, or pasted text. You review everything before saving.
welcome.point2: Every recipe starts out visible only to you. You decide whether to share it with friends or everyone.
welcome.point3: Meal plan, shopping list, and servings rescaled in one tap.
welcome.deleted: Your account and all your data have been deleted.

aiSettings.title: AI and API keys
aiSettings.lead: Mestolo works without AI too. AI features use the app's basic service, if enabled, or your personal key.
aiSettings.freeFeatures: Always free and AI-free: recipe book, link import with structured data, pasted text analysis, basic substitutions, shopping list, meal plan, printing, and export.
aiSettings.usage30: Last 30 days: {user} requests with your key, {app} with the basic service.
aiSettings.keysLead: With your own key, you can use AI features without the app's daily limits. The provider charges your account for usage.
aiSettings.apiKeyHint: It's encrypted on the server and won't be shown again: you'll only see the last 4 characters.
aiSettings.anthropicCaps: Anthropic: analysis, photo reading, translations. Doesn't generate images.
aiSettings.openaiCaps: OpenAI: analysis, photo reading, translations, and image generation.
aiSettings.removeConfirm: The key will be permanently deleted from Mestolo. To revoke it completely, also disable it in the provider's dashboard.
aiSettings.encryptionMissing: The server has no encryption key (APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY): for security, personal keys can't be saved.
aiSettings.costText: The basic service is paid for by the app operator and limited to a few requests per user per day; it can be turned off at any time. With your own key, each request (analysis, photo reading, translation, image) may incur a cost on your account with the provider: before every action, we tell you which key will be used.
aiSettings.privacyText: When you use an AI feature, the necessary content (recipe text or page photos) is sent to the listed provider, which handles it under its own terms. Photos for OCR aren't stored by Mestolo. Your key is used only for actions you start.

privacy.title: Privacy and data
privacy.lead: In short: your recipes are private until you decide otherwise, and we use your data only to run the service.
privacy.data: Email and password (managed by the authentication service), profile, recipes and their history, uploaded images, notes, collections, shopping list, meal plan, friendships, and preferences.
privacy.visibility: Every new recipe is private. You can make it visible to confirmed friends or to all registered users. Permissions are checked by the database on every request, including for images. Personal notes, collections, lists, and meal plans are always private.
privacy.photos: Photos used to import a recipe are processed in memory and sent only to the configured reading provider; Mestolo doesn't store them.
privacy.ai: Analysis, photo reading, translations, and images use external providers (for example Anthropic or OpenAI), which receive only the necessary content and handle it under their own terms. Each feature shows which service it will use.
privacy.keys: Keys you enter are encrypted with a key stored separately from the database, never appear in the browser, logs, or exports, and are used only for actions you start.
privacy.images: Uploaded images are resized and stripped of metadata (including GPS location). Images copied from external sites stay visible only to you.
privacy.export: You can download all your data as JSON and permanently delete your account at any time from settings.
privacy.logs: Technical logs don't contain recipe content, photos, tokens, or API keys.
privacy.operatorNote: The operator of this installation is responsible for data processing and must complete this notice with their own contact details.

terms.title: Community rules
terms.lead: Mestolo is a place to share recipes. By using it, you accept these rules, which apply to everything you make visible to friends or everyone.
terms.conduct: No offensive, discriminatory, violent, sexual, harassing, or misleading content, and no spam or unsolicited advertising.
terms.content: You're responsible for the recipes, text, and images you publish. Recipes are private until you choose to share them.
terms.rights: Share only content that's yours or that you have the right to share. Recipes imported from websites or books are private by default: make them public only if you have the right to, and always credit the source.
terms.safety: Don't publish dangerous instructions. AI suggestions and substitutions are only a guide and don't guarantee suitability for allergies, intolerances, or diets.
terms.moderation: You can report a recipe or block a user at any time. Reports are reviewed; a recipe reported by several people is hidden pending review, and content that breaks the rules is removed.
terms.account: Serious or repeated violations can lead to your account being suspended or deleted. You can delete your account and all your data at any time from settings.
terms.operatorNote: The operator of this installation may supplement these rules with their own terms of service.
